threshold_policy: No threshold inference from this pilot.
information_difference: TN conditions on seed and final syndromes; MWPM uses the final syndrome only. Both use the same physical initial seed repair.
invalid_policy: Every requested history remains in N. With F known failures and U unknown outcomes, TN is bounded by [F/N,(F+U)/N]. No rate is estimated by conditioning on valid contractions.
intervals: Pointwise 95% Wilson for complete binary outcomes; unknown-outcome bounds are not confidence intervals.

metadata.invalid_policy: Invalid, exception, and absent shot outputs are unknown outcomes; retain the requested-history denominator and record attempted and completed TN counts separately.
metadata.mwpm_conditioning: Final syndrome only, after the same physical initial seed repair.
metadata.physical_noise: Independent Z faults with probability p on every seed-H output and every H/CNOT output qubit in the diagonal H+6CNOT circuit.
metadata.posterior_cache: disabled; each Monte Carlo history has its own output
metadata.preparation: Noisy seed-H outputs; complete initial seed MWPM syndrome repair; diagonal H+6CNOT transfer; no later feedback.
metadata.tn_conditioning: Measured preparation syndrome and measured final syndrome, with the known seed-recovery logical shift.
metadata.truth_definition: Logical mask of the full raw fault frame after seed repair, before final decoder recovery; TNfailure is true_mask != logical_mask.
